recipe_version.title: Uzbek Lamb Plov with Carrots, Chickpeas, and a Whole Garlic Head
recipe_version.description: Cubes of lamb shoulder browned with onions and a heap of julienned carrots, simmered with cumin seeds, coriander, and dried chiles into a rich base, then covered with basmati rice, chickpeas, raisins, and a whole head of garlic and steamed until every grain is separate.

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.preparation: cut into matchsticks about 1/4 inch thick

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.display_name: garlic, left whole, loose outer papery skin rubbed off

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cube the lamb and season with 1 1/2 tsp salt. Slice the onions, cut the carrots into matchsticks, and rinse the rice until clear. Drain the chickpeas and rub the loose skin off the garlic head.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 5.5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high, about 3 minutes. Brown the lamb in 2 batches, about 5 minutes per batch, returning all of it to the pot.

steps.title: Onions and carrots
steps.body: Add the onions and cook, stirring, until golden, about 8 minutes. Lay the carrots on top, wait 2 minutes, then stir and cook until the carrots soften, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the base
steps.body: Crush the cumin seeds between your palms over the pot, add the coriander and chiles, and pour in 2 cups water. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on medium-low until the lamb is tender, about 40 minutes.

steps.title: Add the rice
steps.body: Scatter the chickpeas and raisins over the base and spread the rice in an even layer without stirring. Pour 2 1/2 cups water gently over a spatula onto the rice (it should sit 1/2 inch above the rice), add 1 tsp salt, and press the garlic head into the center. Cook uncovered on medium until the liquid sinks below the surface of the rice, about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Steam
steps.body: Gather the rice into a dome, poke 5 holes to the bottom with the spatula handle, cover tightly, and steam on low for 20 minutes. Rest covered off the heat 10 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Turn the plov out onto the large platter, rice first and lamb and carrots on top, with the garlic head in the middle for squeezing.

coverage_contribution: Lamb appears as koobideh, kofta, cumin stir-fry, and kibbeh; there is no Central Asian dish and no one-pot meat pilaf. A long, mostly hands-off weekend meal.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with persian-lamb-koobideh-saffron-rice: lamb chunks steamed into carrot-cumin rice in one pot, not grilled minced kebabs with saffron rice. Compared with xian-cumin-lamb-stir-fry: a slow-simmered pilaf, not a fast wok stir-fry. Compared with vegetable-biryani-cashews: unlayered cumin-carrot rice with lamb, no yogurt, cashews, or garam masala.
not_duplicate_of: Not biryani (no yogurt marinade or layered masala) and not Persian polo.
